releaseNotes:
v1.4.10 - Hotfix: App stuck on icon

Fixed startup crash that prevented the app from opening after v1.4.9.

Root cause: QuickActions.setShortcutItems() and requestExactAlarmsPermission() were called before runApp(), causing a crash on some devices before the app UI was ever shown.

Fix:
- Wrapped QuickActions initialization in try-catch so any failure is non-fatal
- Moved notification permission request out of main() - it now only happens when the user toggles reminders in Settings
- Variable scoping fix so quickActions is accessible to runApp()
